import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    A,B,e0,k1,k3,c0,d,d2,c1,c2 = [params[i] for i in range(10)]
    w=0.4
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    th=np.tanh(v)
    return A*C+B*S+e0+k1*x+k3*x**3+c0*v+d*th+d2*v*np.abs(v)+c1*th*C+c2*th*S
